description: Make the pending backend changes of a builder app live (see pending in builder_backend_status). Changes that only add go live at once. Changes that delete saved data (a table or field removed, a type changed) come back as needsConfirm with applied = false and nothing changed: tell the person exactly what is deleted, ask, and call again with confirmDataLoss: true; a backup is taken first (backupId). No credits. Pass confirm: true. Developer role. Pro and Team (a live backend).

confirmDataLoss.description: true only after the person agreed to the listed data deletions
